visual_fidelity_check.priority: HIGHEST - do this BEFORE font sweep
visual_fidelity_check.instruction: Compare the Paper artboard against the reference screenshot captured during source-audit. This is the single most important verification step. If something looks different, fix it.
method: 1. Take a get_screenshot of the full Paper artboard
2. Compare it visually against the reference screenshot of the running page
3. For each section, ask: does this LOOK like the real page? Not 'did I use the right tokens' - does it visually match?
4. Flag every section where the Paper version diverges from the real page
5. Fix divergences before proceeding to font sweep
common_failures: Images replaced with gradient boxes - the real page has photos/screenshots, Paper has colored rectangles
Interactive components look nothing like source - hand-drawn HTML approximation vs real rendered component
Proportions wrong - cards too tall/short, gaps too wide/narrow vs actual rendered page
Missing content - elements visible in the real page that were omitted or simplified

image_audit.instruction: Verify every image from the source-audit image_inventory appears in the Paper artboard. Missing images = failed extraction.
image_audit.check: For each image in the inventory: is it present in Paper as a paper-asset:// image? If not, insert it now.

checks.name: Font
checks.question: Does the typeface match the source?

checks.name: Images
checks.question: Are all source images present? No gradient placeholders?

checks.name: Fidelity
checks.question: Would someone familiar with the real page recognize this as the same page?

font_sweep.on_results: batch update_styles all to source font
font_sweep.why: Paper defaults every Text node to system-ui, sans-serif. This is the only reliable catch.

verify: Font family is source font, NOT system-ui
No node carries transition or animation (Paper drops them; motion lives in frame strips)
